items.source: beanKey - the key associated with the MBean in the beans map of the MBeanExporter
items.translation: beanKey - beans 映射中与 MBeanExporter 中的 MBean 关联的键

items.source: You can supply an array of method names via the managedMethods property. If you have multiple beans and you wish each bean to use a different set of method names, then you can map bean keys (that is the name used to pass the bean to the MBeanExporter) to a list of method names using the methodMappings property.
items.translation: 您可以通过 `managedMethods` 属性提供方法名数组。如果您有多个 Bean，并希望每个 Bean 使用不同的方法名集合，则可以使用 `methodMappings` 属性将 Bean 键（即传递给 `MBeanExporter` 时使用的 Bean 名称）映射到方法名列表。

items.source: If you specify values for both methodMappings and managedMethods, Spring will attempt to find method names in the mappings first. If no method names for the bean are found, it will use the method names defined by managedMethods.
items.translation: 如果您同时为 `methodMappings` 和 `managedMethods` 指定了值，Spring 将首先在映射中查找方法名。如果未在映射中找到该 Bean 的方法名，它将使用由 `managedMethods` 定义的方法名。

items.source: Set the array of method names to use for creating the management info. These method names will be used for a bean if no entry corresponding to that bean is found in the methodMappings property.
items.translation: 设置用于创建管理信息的类方法名称数组。如果未在 `methodMappings` 属性中找到对应该类的条目，则这些方法名称将用于该类 Bean。

items.source: Allows subclasses to vote on the inclusion of a particular operation.
items.translation: 允许子类对特定操作的包含进行投票。

items.source: Allows subclasses to vote on the inclusion of a particular attribute accessor.
items.translation: 允许子类对特定属性访问器的包含进行投票。

items.source: Allows subclasses to vote on the inclusion of a particular attribute mutator.
items.translation: 允许子类对特定属性修改器的包含进行投票。

items.source:
Set the mappings of bean keys to a comma-separated list of method names.
The property key should match the bean key and the property value should match
the list of method names. When searching for method names for a bean, Spring
will check these mappings first.
items.translation: 将 Bean 键的映射设置为方法名的逗号分隔列表。属性键应与 Bean 键匹配，属性值应与方法名列表匹配。在搜索 Bean 的方法名时，Spring 将首先检查这些映射。

items.source: methodNames - an array of method names indicating the methods to use
items.translation: methodNames - 一个方法名数组，指示要使用的方法。

items.source: mappings - the mappings of bean keys to method names
items.translation: mappings - 将 Bean 键映射到方法名的映射关系
